verses.text: The Song of Songs, which is Solomon's, surpassing all songs.
With my mouth, I will make supplication;
The fragrance of your ointments is better than all spices;
When I turn to you, your fragrance shall draw me near;
O you daughters of Jerusalem, I am dark, yet lovely;
For the sun has scorched me;
Tell me, you whom my soul loves;
O you who are fairest among women;
My beloved is like a gazelle or a young stag;
Your cheeks are beautiful like the pomegranates, very delightful.
ባለ ብር ጕብጕብ የሆነ የወርቅ ጠልሰም ያድርጉልሽ።
ንጉሡ በማዕድ እስከሚቀርብ ድረስ፥
ውዴ ለእኔ በጡቶች መካከል እንደሚያርፍ
ልጅ ወንድሜ ለእኔ በዐይንጋዲ ወይን ቦታ እንዳለ
ወዳጄ ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ ውብ ነሽ፤
ልጅ ወንድሜ ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ አንተ ውብ ነህ፥
የቤታችን ሰረገላ የዝግባ ዛፍ ነው፥
እኔ የዱር ጽጌረዳ፥ የቈላም የሱፍ አበባ ነኝ።
በእሾህ መካከል እንዳለ የሱፍ አበባ፥
በዱር እንዳለ እንኮይ፥
ወደ ወይን ቤት አገቡኝ፥
በሽቱ አጸኑኝ፥
ቀኙ ታቅፈኛለች።
እናንተ የኢየሩሳሌም ቈነጃጅት ሆይ፥
እነሆ፥ የልጅ ወንድሜ ቃል በተራሮች ላይ ሲዘልል፥
ልጅ ወንድሜ በቤቴል ተራሮች ላይ ሚዳቋን ወይም የዋሊያን እንምቦሳ ይመስላል፤
ልጅ ወንድሜ እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰልኝ፦
እነሆ፥ ክረምቱ ዐለፈ፥
አበባ በምድር ላይ ታየ፥
በለሱ ጐመራ፥ ወይኖችም አበቡ፥
ፊትህን አሳየኝ፥
የወይን ቦታችን ያብብ ዘንድ፥
ልጅ ወንድሜ የእኔ ነው፥ እኔም የእርሱ ነኝ፤
ልጅ ወንድሜ ሆይ፥ ቀኑ እስኪነፍስ፥
Night upon my dwelling place
I shall declare, and I shall arise in the city;
Let me find the watchmen who keep the city;
And among them, I shall rest a little;
O ye daughters of Jerusalem,
Her stature is like that of a palm tree, and her breasts are like clusters of grapes;
Behold, she is the bed of Solomon;
All are armed with swords and are trained for battle;
The king Solomon's chariot
He made its pillars of silver, its bottom of gold;
እናንት የጽዮን ቈነጃጅት፥
O my beloved, behold, thou art fair;
Thy cheeks are as a bed of spices, as sweet flowers;
Thy lips are like a thread of scarlet, and thy speech is comely;
Thy neck is as a tower of ivory, fashioned for a trophy, like the tower of David;
Thy two breasts are like two young roes that are twins;
Until the day break, and the shadows flee away,
O my beloved, thou art all fair,
O thou fairest among women, thou art as a lily among thorns;
My sister, O thou fairest, thou hast stolen my heart;
My sister, O thou fairest, how delightful are thy breasts!
O my beloved, let the fragrance of your myrrh be wafted forth;
My sister, my beloved, is a garden enclosed,
Your pathway is a fragrant aroma and a choice fruit,
With the spice of nard and the fragrance of saffron,
Thou art a fountain of gardens, a well of living waters,
O north wind, arise,
My sister, O my dove, I have entered into my garden,
I was asleep, but my heart was awake;
I have taken off my robe; how shall I put it on again?
My beloved has put his hand by the hole of the door;
I arose to open to my beloved;
I opened to my beloved,
The watchmen that go about the city found me;
O ye daughters of Jerusalem,
Thou art beautiful among women;
My beloved is white and ruddy,
ራሱ ምዝምዝ ወርቅ ነው፤
ዐይኖቹ በሙሉ የውኃ ኵሬ አጠገብ እንዳሉ
ጕንጮቹ ሽቱን የሚያፈስሱ የሽቱ መደብ ናቸው።
እጆቹ የተርሴስ ፈርጥ እንዳለባቸው እንደ ለዘቡ የወርቅ ቀለበቶች ናቸው፤
እግሮቹ በምዝምዝ ወርቅ እንደ ተመሠረቱ
ጕሮሮው እጅግ ጣፋጭ ነው፥ ሁለንተናውም የተወደደ ነው፤
O thou who art most beautiful among women,
My beloved, may the angel of the garden keep watch over thee,
I am my beloved's, and my beloved is mine;
O my love, thou art fair as the morning star,
Turn thine eyes away from me, for they have overcome me;
Thy lips are like a thread of scarlet,
Besides thy silence, thy voice is sweet;
Sixty queens there are, and eighty concubines,
Yet my dove, my perfect one, is but one;
This one is as the dawn, fair and bright, that cometh to me.
My child, do not despise your brother or your sister.
There, I shall give you milk.
There, I shall give you milk.
አንቺ ሱላማጢስ ሆይ፥ ተመለሽ፥ ተመለሽ፤
አንቺ የአሚናዳብ ልጅ ሆይ፥
እንብርትሽ የወይን ጠጅ እንደማይጐድልበት እንደ ተነጠጠ ጽዋ ነው፤
ሁለቱ ጡቶችሽ እንደ ሁለት መንታ
አንገትሽ እንደ ዝሆን ጥርስ ግንብ ነው፤
በራስሽ ላይ ያለው ጠጕርሽ እንደ ቀርሜሎስ ተራራ ነው፤
ወዳጄ ሆይ፥ እንዴት የተዋብሽ ነሽ!
ይህ ቁመትሽ የዘንባባ ዛፍ ይመስላል፥
ወደ ዘንባባው ዛፍ እወጣለሁ
ጕሮሮሽም ለልጅ ወንድሜ እየጣፈጠ እንደሚገባ፥
I am the son of my brother, and his return is unto me.
O my son, arise, and let us go forth to the field.
Let us go to the place of the vine;
Give the harvests to the reapers.
O my son, who is it that has given you to suck the breast of my mother?
Behold, I go unto my mother's house, and unto my father, and I will lay down where you have brought me.
The day she passed away, her left side was beneath me.
O ye daughters of Jerusalem,
Who is she that cometh up as a rose, leaning upon her beloved, as a morning dawn that breaks forth?
As a girdle upon thy heart,
Many waters cannot quench love, neither can the floods drown it;
Our sister is little, and she hath no breasts;
If she be a wall, we will build upon her a palace of silver;
I am a wall, and my breasts are as towers;
ለሰሎሞን በብኤላሞን የወይን ቦታ ነበረው፤
ለእኔ ያለኝ የወይን ቦታ በፊቴ ነው፤
በአትክልቱ ቦታ ሲኖር ሌሎች አዩት፥
ልጅ ወንድሜ ሆይ፥ ፍጠን፤
